FlexibleHierarchyNodeRela.name: FlexibleHierarchyNodeRela
FlexibleHierarchyNodeRela.description: Represents the type of relationship between any two nodes in an hierarchy. For instance, a parent-subsidiary relationship between companies or an individual's affiliation with a company.

CurrencyIsoCode.description: Three-letter ISO currency code associated with the hierarchy.

FlexibleHierarchyId.description: The Flexible Hierarchy that's associated with the flexible hierarchy node.

LastReferencedDate.description: The most recent date when a user referenced this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The most recent date when a user viewed this record.

PredecessorNodeId.description: The parent node associated with the relationship that's defined by this record.

RelatedRecord.description: The related record that provides additional context for this node relationship, such as an Account Account Relation record.

RelatedRecordObject.description: The API name of the object that's the related record in this flexible hierarchy node relation.

SourceSystemIdentifier.description: The unique identifier of this record in an external system.

SourceSystemName.description: The name of the external system this record was obtained from.

SuccessorNodeId.description: The child node associated with the relationship that's defined by this record.
